lanes.name: Intent and Purpose
lanes.question: Why should this work exist, for whom, and toward what legitimate outcome?

lanes.name: Authority and Accountability
lanes.question: Who may request, approve, execute, intervene and own the outcome?

lanes.name: Context and Grounding
lanes.question: What evidence, assumptions, sources and constraints ground the work?

lanes.name: Data and Knowledge Stewardship
lanes.question: What information is used, at what classification, under which access and retention rules?

lanes.name: Capability and Tooling
lanes.question: Which certified capability, runtime, model and tools are fit for purpose?

lanes.name: Risk, Safety and Ethics
lanes.question: What can go wrong, who may be harmed and which controls reduce exposure?

lanes.name: Execution and Orchestration
lanes.question: How will work be decomposed, bounded, observed, interrupted and recovered?

lanes.name: Assurance and Evidence
lanes.question: How will correctness, compliance, provenance and reproducibility be demonstrated?

lanes.name: Learning and Evolution
lanes.question: What may be learned, promoted, deprecated or changed after review?
